title: Enigma PM Runbook
subtitle: Eversys Enigma | E'2c, E'2s, E'2ms, E'4s, E'4ms, E'6s, E'6ms (Classic and ST) | preventive maintenance kits and steps
sources: Based on the Enigma | Shotmaster | E'choco PM Kits Manual V4.0 (SAP 5700111715, 01.05.2026), TI-240, and the e'Support history of service kit releases V3.0 (12.10.2026). X-Wide units use the X-Wide runbook. Check the Webshop configurator with the machine's serial number before ordering.

banners.text: Updated October 2026 to the PM Kits Manual V4.0: 24-month kits are now 36-month kits (TI-240). Old 24-month kits in stock can be used for the 36-month PM.
E'2c has no steam boiler: no steam, hot water or milk kits.
No milk system on this model, so milk-module and frame kits are not listed.
The manual gives no two-1.5-Step setup for the E'2ms. Check the unit.
The manual lists no 2-outlet E'choco add-on (EV111934) for this model. Check with the Webshop configurator.
12-month PM: only 12-month kits are listed. Hydraulic kits and the Everfoam, milk and hot water add-ons are 36-month items.

items.text: Check ground-coffee total: change burrs after every 2000 kg.
Clean the grinder at every service.
Clean, then apply a thin layer of grease (JAX Pyro-plate FGN) to the threads of the upper burr support so the burrs cannot jam.
Fit kit EV117077 on each brew unit.
Clean, then grease the shafts of the bottom arm and the top piston with JAX Pyro-plate FGN.
Check the piston screens for clogging. Clean or replace if needed.
Turn each piston screen 1/4 turn to lock it on the piston head, then tighten the piston head to 8 N·m.
Fit EV109586 on each hydraulic module.
Fit EV102865 for E'choco.
Fit EV109590 for the adjustable Americano.
Check the heating element and boiler for scale. Descale with Eversys descaler (PI-19) if needed.
Fit EV108389 and the steam add-ons listed in section 2.
Apply Loctite Permabond MM115 pure to the thread of the air injector when reassembling.
Check the heating element and boiler for scale. Descale with Eversys descaler (PI-19) if needed.
Fit EV108339.
Fit EV108340.
Change the milk pipes (every 12 months). 25 m blue 106186, green 106189.
Apply Loctite Permabond MM115 pure to the thread of the air injector when reassembling.
Fit the frame add-on kits listed in section 2 (EV108351 and/or EV108364).
Cut the tubes to the machine's dimensions. Clean the 1.5-Step outlet, the fitting silicone pipe and the aerator.
Fit EV109706.
Fit EV111934 for the second outlet.
Record the service (date, interval, kits used). Old 24-month kits may be used for the 36-month interval.

stockNote.title: 24-month kits in stock are still usable.

reference.title: Interval rule
reference.text: Under 50,000 cycles a year per group head: 12-month PM in years 1 and 2, 36-month PM in year 3, then repeat. Over 50,000: the same 12, 12, 36 pattern every 50,000 cycles. At least one PM a year is mandatory.

reference.title: Identify the model from the serial
reference.text: The first 8 digits of the serial give the model (e'Support, List of machine serial numbers - North America). Classic: E'2c 01106800, E'2s 01106900, E'2ms 01108400, E'4s 01107000, E'4ms 01107100, E'6s 01159800, E'6ms 01159900. ST: E'2c 01165300, E'2s 01165400, E'2ms 01165500, E'4s 01165600, E'4ms 01165700, E'6s 01165800, E'6ms 01165900.
